# /etc/systemd/system/aura-face-zone-editor.service
[Unit]
Description=AURA face boundary display
After=aura-avatar-ui.service
PartOf=aura-avatar-ui.service
[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -B /home/root/aura-native-live-20261024/ops/be72669aa53de735/pan-face-edge-v5/zone-editor-recenter-v1/face_zone_editor.py --settings /home/root/aura-pan-current-20261024/da36c36a/face-zone-settings.json
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=3
[Install]
WantedBy=aura-avatar-ui.service
